en.kitchen: A runner carries a handover note to the next chef. Reading parts of that note as departure orders can change what the runner does. The accepted instruction change separates those roles, but remains experimental, undistributed and untested in this review.

en.kitchen: Put the handover on its own sheet and pass its contents together. Keep a clear dividing point between instructions for the runner and the note for the receiving chef. That is the narrow change shown in the accepted example.
